name: null_regions
description: Circular-shift null of every tested region and statistic, for V18 (GIPPA_SPEC.md §7.3.5(b), §10.2; docs/specs/M9-17-plot-support-analysis.md). The values are the statistic each test compares: for o_minus_e the ADR-0018 studentised sum(d - p) / sqrt(sum p (1 - p)), for hl_shift the studentised T = HL / sqrt(V) of ADR-0018's amendments, not the reported effect. Written by the context_stats step while the file stays under 5 MB (2^20 bytes per MB); otherwise the file holds the 1st-99th percentile grid of each null and its header's fourth column is percentile (1-99) instead of shift_k (schema plot_support/null_regions_grid.json). Not a result table.

fields.name: contig
fields.description: Replicon the region was tested on (a region split across contigs has one null per contig)

fields.name: stat
fields.description: Test statistic of the region test

fields.name: shift_k
fields.description: Circular gene-index shift k of the null draw (percentile 1-99 in the percentile-grid form of the file)

fields.name: null_value
fields.description: The studentised statistic at this shift (or the null's percentile in the grid form); NA when undefined

fields.name: observed
fields.description: The observed studentised statistic the null is compared with
